sets.title: Wheels that also interact
sets.query: manamap pilot card-search --deck sharknado --all --oracle '(discards? (their|your) hand|discard any number|shuffles? (their|your) hand|puts? (their|your) hand on the bottom|each player (discards|shuffles)|then draws? (that many|seven|cards equal))' --oracle '(counter target|destroy (target|all|each)|exile (target|all|each)|return (target|all|each).{0,40}(owner|hand)|deals? \d+ damage to (target|each|any)|damage to any target)' --limit 60

cards.name: Fateful Showdown
cards.why: instant: damage equal to your hand size to any target, then discard the hand and draw that many

cards.name: Collective Defiance
cards.why: escalate: wheel yourself (discard all, draw that many) plus 4 to a creature and 3 to an opponent

cards.name: Incendiary Command
cards.why: choose two: everyone wheels, 2 to each creature, 4 to a player — a wheel with a small sweeper

cards.name: The Elder Dragon War
cards.why: saga: 2 to each creature and opponent, then discard any and draw that many, then a 4/4 flying Dragon

cards.name: Rites of Refusal
cards.why: instant: discard any number to counter a spell unless they pay 3 per card — the discard IS the counter

cards.name: Null Brooch
cards.why: discard your hand: counter a noncreature spell, every turn — a counterspell on a stick, no draw

cards.name: Snort
cards.why: each player may wheel to five; every opponent who does takes 5; flashback wheels again

cards.name: Moonveil Regent
cards.why: flyer: on every spell you may discard your hand and draw one per colour of that spell — a repeatable wheel

cards.name: Jace, the Mind Sculptor
cards.why: 0: draw three, put two back every turn; −1 bounces a creature — a Game Changer

cards.name: Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant // Phoenix, Warden of Fire
cards.why: enters: discard two, draw two; flips into a saga that burns each opponent and returns creatures

cards.name: Cathartic Pyre
cards.why: instant, choose one: 3 to a creature or planeswalker, OR discard two and draw two — not both

cards.name: Day's Undoing
cards.why: everyone shuffles hand and graveyard back and draws seven; ends your turn; no interaction

cards.name: Hex Magic
cards.why: exile your hand and draw that many, playable next turn — exile is not discard, so no Brallin

cards.name: Into the Fire
cards.why: choose one: 2 to every creature, OR bottom any number and draw that many plus one — a bottom, so no Brallin

cards.name: Invasion of Kaldheim // Pyre of the World Tree
cards.why: enters: exile hand, draw that many (Shabraz); flipped, each land you discard pings any target for 2 (Brallin)

cards.name: Chandra, Heart of Fire
cards.why: +1 discard your hand and impulse three; +1 2 damage to any target — a discard with no draw

cards.name: Chandra, Flame's Catalyst
cards.why: +1 3 to each opponent every turn; −8 discard your hand, draw seven and cast them free

cards.name: Umaro, Raging Yeti
cards.why: each combat, at random: team pump, discard your hand and draw four, or 5 to any target — random

cards.name: Ajani Unrelenting
cards.why: −2 discard your hand, draw one per creature; −3 4 to each creature but your tokens

cards.name: Chandra Ablaze
cards.why: +1 discard a red card for 4 to any target; −2 everyone discards their hand and draws three

cards.name: Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker
cards.why: −3 4 to a creature; +1 a 4/4 flying haste Dragon; ultimate draws two and discards the hand each turn

cards.name: Serum Powder
cards.why: a mana rock; its hand reset works only at mulligan, so it pays neither commander

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.why: exile ALL permanents (yours too) and discard your hand — a total reset

cards.name: Colossus of the Blood Age
cards.why: enters: 3 to each opponent, gain 3; dies: discard any number, draw that many plus one

cards.name: Turtles in Time
cards.why: bounce every creature, then everyone may shuffle hand and graveyard back and draw seven — a 7-mana reset

sets.title: Free interaction for the wheel turn (DeckCheck roast, 2026-10-18)
sets.query: DeckCheck Explore Cards, Scryfall: id<=urw t:instant mv<=3 f:commander usd<10 (alternative or discounted costs) (counter|destroy|exile|damage); 32 results, 4 kept

cards.name: March of Swirling Mist
cards.why: instant, X blue cards from hand pay for it: phase out up to X creatures — both commanders dodge spot removal AND a wrath, paid with the fresh hand the wheel just dealt

cards.name: Snapback
cards.why: instant, exile a blue card from hand instead of paying: bounce a creature — a free answer with the mana tapped, or bounce Brallin in response to removal

cards.name: Flare of Denial
cards.why: instant, sacrifice a nontoken blue creature instead of paying: counter target spell — a hard counter for zero mana off a spent Archivist or Skulker

cards.name: March of Otherworldly Light
cards.why: instant, exile an artifact, creature or enchantment with mana value X or less; white cards from hand reduce it — a second Swords that also hits Rhystic Study and Smothering Tithe

sets.title: Protection that also beats a wrath (DeckCheck roast, query 2, 2026-10-18)
sets.query: DeckCheck Explore Cards, Scryfall: id<=urw t:instant mv<=3 f:commander usd<10 (phase out|indestructible|hexproof|protection from) -"you control gain"; 49 results, 3 kept (+ March of Swirling Mist, already in free-interaction)

cards.name: Blacksmith's Skill
cards.why: one white: target PERMANENT gains hexproof and indestructible — a commander against spot removal or a destroy wrath, or Smothering Tithe against the artifact hate; Loran's Escape is the same card with scry 1 on a creature or artifact

cards.name: Valorous Stance
cards.why: two mana, modal: indestructible on one creature, OR destroy a creature with toughness 4 or more — protection that is removal when nothing needs saving

cards.name: Final Showdown
cards.why: spree, from one white: +1 one creature indestructible, +1 ALL creatures lose abilities until end of turn (an instant-speed stop on a combo creature), +5 destroy all creatures — a protection spell that is also the deck's only wrath

sets.title: Instant-speed draw and discard that also interacts (DeckCheck roast, query 3, 2026-10-18)
sets.query: DeckCheck Explore Cards, Scryfall: id<=urw t:instant mv<=3 f:commander usd<10 o:draw (o:discard or o:"each player"); 47 results, 6 kept (Cathartic Pyre already on wheel-interaction, Tolarian Winds already in the deck)

cards.name: Prismari Command
cards.why: three mana, choose two: 2 damage anywhere, a player loots two, a Treasure, destroy an artifact — removal and a loot in one card, Brallin and Shabraz both trigger

cards.name: Izzet Charm
cards.why: two mana, choose one: soft-counter a noncreature spell, 2 to a creature, or draw two discard two — the cheapest card here that is interaction on their turn and fuel on ours

cards.name: Three Steps Ahead
cards.why: spree from one blue: +{1}{U} counter a spell, +{2} draw two discard one, +{3} copy a creature or artifact — a hard counter that loots when the mana is there, a loot when it is not

cards.name: You Find the Villains' Lair
cards.why: three mana, choose one: hard counter, or draw two discard two — Counterspell with a loot mode; Refute is the same slot with both halves at once

cards.name: Frantic Search
cards.why: draw two, discard two, untap three lands: a free instant-speed loot — two Brallin pings and two Shabraz counters on the wheel turn for no net mana

cards.name: Dangerous Wager
cards.why: two mana instant: discard your hand, draw two — a seven-card hand is 7 damage to each opponent through Brallin at instant speed, and a fresh two after a counterspell fight

sets.title: DeckCheck Synergetic Cards tab, the ones that fit the wheel-turn experiment (2026-10-18)
sets.query: DeckCheck Explore Cards > Synergetic Cards for N381DOgjy9ZU, 300 by relevance; 6 kept

cards.name: Teferi, Master of Time
cards.why: loyalty abilities at instant speed on ANY turn: +1 loot (Brallin and Shabraz trigger on every player's turn, three or four times a round), -3 phases out a creature they control — removal and fuel on their turns

cards.name: Swan Song
cards.why: one blue: hard counter for an enchantment, instant or sorcery — the one counter cheap enough to hold up on the wheel turn; they get a 2/2 Bird

cards.name: Heartwarming Redemption
cards.why: four-mana INSTANT: discard your hand, draw that many plus one, gain life equal to the new hand — a self-wheel on their end step: seven Brallin pings, eight Shabraz draws and a life gain that is a counter again

cards.name: Captain Howler, Sea Scourge
cards.why: ward 2 + 2 life; whenever you discard, target creature gets +2/+0 per card discarded and draws on combat damage — a seven-card wheel is +14/+0 on a flying Shabraz, commander damage in one swing

cards.name: Cool but Rude
cards.why: Class, level 2 for {1}{R} more: whenever you discard a card, 2 damage to each opponent — a second Brallin that doubles every wheel; the goldfish cannot buy a Class level yet, so it stays dark until modelled

cards.name: Monument to Endurance
cards.why: three colourless: on each discard choose one not yet chosen this turn — draw, a Treasure, or each opponent loses 3 — every wheel turn pays all three; colourless, so it dodges the mana base the roast mocked
